en.content: The increasing order of reactivity of the following compounds towards aromatic electrophilic substitution reaction is :
en.explanation:
In aromatic electrophilic substitution reaction, electrofile attacks to the ring whose electron density is more.

Note : -M effect is more powerful than -I effect, that is why electron density will be less in the ring for -M effect.

en.content:
Among the following, the set of parameters that represents path function, is :
(A) q + w
(B) q
(C) w
(D) H–TS
en.explanation:
(A) q + w = E, state function

(B) q, Path function

(C) w, Path function

(D) H – TS = G, State function
